# playlist-data-engine

> Parse Arweave serverless music playlists into clean data, resolve alternate mixes and lossy/lossless audio quality, and reach files through automatic gateway failover — the engine behind ar://listen.

The docs live inside the npm package itself, version-matched to your install: `node_modules/playlist-data-engine/docs/`. Also readable via `npx playlist-data-engine docs <topic>`, and programmatically via the exported `engineHelp()`.

## Core (music player infrastructure)

- [docs/DATA_ENGINE_REFERENCE.md](docs/DATA_ENGINE_REFERENCE.md): every public function, one row each — signatures, inputs, outputs
- [docs/USAGE_IN_OTHER_PROJECTS.md](docs/USAGE_IN_OTHER_PROJECTS.md): install, main vs gateway entry, first parsed playlist
- [docs/features/PLAYLIST_PARSING.md](docs/features/PLAYLIST_PARSING.md): loading playlists, track objects, alternate mixes (pins, alias matching, lossy/lossless pairs)
- [docs/features/GATEWAY_RESOLUTION.md](docs/features/GATEWAY_RESOLUTION.md): gateway failover, Wayfinder, resolving tx and IPFS URLs

## Audio analysis

- [docs/features/AUDIO_ANALYSIS.md](docs/features/AUDIO_ANALYSIS.md): BPM, key, mood, genre classification (TensorFlow + essentia)
- [docs/features/BEAT_DETECTION.md](docs/features/BEAT_DETECTION.md): beat streams and rhythm-game chart generation

## Game systems (RPG-from-audio)

- [docs/features/COMBAT_SYSTEM.md](docs/features/COMBAT_SYSTEM.md): seeded combat simulations driven by track energy
- [docs/features/ENEMY_GENERATION.md](docs/features/ENEMY_GENERATION.md): characters generated from sonic fingerprints
- [docs/features/EQUIPMENT_SYSTEM.md](docs/features/EQUIPMENT_SYSTEM.md): loot and equipment
- [docs/features/XP_AND_STATS.md](docs/features/XP_AND_STATS.md): progression and persistence
- [docs/features/ROLLS_AND_SEEDS.md](docs/features/ROLLS_AND_SEEDS.md): deterministic seeded dice
- [docs/features/IRL_SENSORS.md](docs/features/IRL_SENSORS.md): weather, time, motion context
- [docs/features/CONTENT_PACKS.md](docs/features/CONTENT_PACKS.md) / [CUSTOM_CONTENT.md](docs/features/CUSTOM_CONTENT.md) / [EXTENSIBILITY_GUIDE.md](docs/features/EXTENSIBILITY_GUIDE.md) / [PREREQUISITES.md](docs/features/PREREQUISITES.md): extending the engine

## For AI agents

- `engineHelp()` (exported from both package entries) returns this index as markdown; `engineHelp('<topic>')` returns where to read one doc
- `engineHelp('skill')` returns the companion Claude Code skill file (also `npx playlist-data-engine skill`)
- TypeScript users: the `.d.ts` in dist/ is the complete API surface with JSDoc
